mira: Quick follow-up from the PM  consolidated action items below. Please ACK and drop Jira IDs when created. 5 items total, two are recurring checks. Due dates are tentative.

jonathan: ack. I'll take A1 (model rollback playbook + quick rollback checklist).

sarah: I'll own A2 (alerting thresholds + dashboards audit).

kevin: taking A3 (cache eviction runbook + TTL alignment). Will coordinate with infra.

mira: RACI draft: A1 - R: jonathan, A: mira, C: kevin, I: product-ops. A2 - R: sarah, A: kevin, C: eng-sre, I: infra. A3 - R: kevin, A: mira, C: ops-bot, I: customer-success. A4 (quarterly cache audit) - R: kevin, A: mira, C: eng-ml, I: product.

product-ops: Noted. I'll schedule customer notifications for items that affect SLAs once we have verification steps.

ops-bot: Reminder: please add due dates in Jira within 48h or task will be flagged for triage by the bot.

jonathan: INC-7892 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-7892  due 2026-04-10. Added checklist: `rollback_steps.md` and quick smoke tests.

sarah: AUD-102 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/AUD-102  due 2026-04-08. I'll attach sample alert graphs and a test plan.

kevin: PM-4321 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PM-4321  target 2026-04-05. Noted recurring cache-TTL mismatch pattern; proposing quarterly audit (A4)  target 2026-07-01.

mira: Good call on recurring pattern. I've added A4 to the PM doc and updated the RACI there.

jonathan: Quick question  who verifies rollout after fixes? Suggest R: kevin, V (verification): customer-success/product-ops. Thoughts?

product-ops: We'll own verification coordination and checklist items. Assign V to customer-success for external validation.

sarah: ack. I'll pin the dashboard queries to AUD-102 for quick validation and include thresholds to test against.

mira: Thanks everyone. If no objections, I'll update the postmortem with the Jira links, final RACI matrix, and a timeline summary by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup: 

kevin: :thumbsup:
